svg.title: ShipShow
svg.desc: ShipShow: turn a shit show into a ship show. Narrated videos of what your agents did, and the calls they need from you. Beside the name, a 1:41 decision video as ShipShow makes it, asking: close the invoice leak? Three options: routes off, in minutes; an ownership check, in about an hour, recommended; and row-level security, in days. A caption reads: the agent recommends option B.
svg.text: // TURN A SHIT SHOW INTO A SHIP SHOW
